activity_summary: Kemp said, kindly, that you never sounded so near death. You had got through Egeon on breath and consonants. There was no quarrel in it, and no tally. You left the yard.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Said the line kindly and refused a quarrel.

entities.name: Augustine Phillips
entities.context: Named the breath and the consonants, and told you to go home.

entities.name: The Comedy of Errors
entities.context: Mentioned in Kindly, and near it

facets.activity: Heard Kemp say near death, kindly, and went

quotes.speaker: will_kemp
quotes.text: You never sounded so near death, and I say it kindly.

quotes.speaker: augustine_phillips
quotes.text: On breath and on the consonants.
